facts.fact: Ponatshego, an online marketplace incubated by Tsoga Africa, secured P250,000 (USD 22,000) from members of Angel Network Botswana in May 2021, per the World Bank.
Ponatshego's P250,000 (USD 22,000) investment in May 2021 came from members of Angel Network Botswana, a Botswana investor network, per the World Bank.

Insurtech Alpha Direct, based in Gaborone, has raised USD 3.2 million in total, starting with seed capital from an American investor and followed by further capital, per the World Bank; no date is given, so the report's December 2021 publication date is used.
